📖 How to use

  1. Type the elements of set A, separated by commas or new lines.
  2. Type the elements of set B the same way.
  3. All six operations — union, intersection, both differences, symmetric difference and cardinality — update instantly.
  4. Check whether one set is a subset of the other or whether the sets are equal.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I enter a set?

Type elements separated by commas, semicolons, spaces or new lines — for example: apple, banana, cherry. Duplicates are removed automatically.

What is the symmetric difference?

The symmetric difference A △ B contains elements that are in exactly one of the two sets — everything in the union except the intersection.

Are elements case-sensitive?

Yes. 'Apple' and 'apple' are treated as different elements, because sets distinguish values exactly as typed.
